summary: Wrote a 7-phase implementation plan (10.5h, 6 dependency waves) for the shellcheck gate. Re-measured the findings at plan time and reproduced the research report exactly: 196 findings across 82 of 359 tracked files, identical per-code histogram. The plan lands the lint script and its both-polarity fixture test first, then four serialized fix passes (real defects, mechanical hygiene, SC2034 core, SC2034 non-core), then the numbered-gate wiring plus redeploy last so the gate is green the moment it becomes enforceable. Three research corrections are folded in: manifest.json registration is required and was omitted; git ls-files alone cannot serve the mktemp fixture test; five range literals need bumping, not two.

artifacts.summary: 7-phase plan to add a shellcheck lint gate to the agent-system source store and clear all 196 current findings before the gate is wired.
